https://arcprize.org/leaderboard

Super cool to see this chart, also, really cool to be outperforming some of these SOTA models and to see many on the leaderboard do the same.

A bit discouraging to hope to hit 100% with GPT-5.6 Sol being bellow 10%, yet I suppose we all love very difficult problems and it should at the same time fire all of us up a bit.

Any thoughts?
